experience.playerFantasy: You hold temporary authority over the last working train in a flooded region and decide its route, passengers, risks, repairs, and rescues.
experience.emotionalPromise: A tense but humane railway road trip where practical choices build a crew, change the train, and make every arrival feel earned.
experience.commonKnowledgeBoundary: A familiar near-present disaster world of stations, tunnels, small towns, storms, shortages, and ordinary people; no specialist railway knowledge is required.
experience.openingObjective: Restart the stranded train, choose the first branch of track, and reach Dawn Junction before the river overtops the final bridge.

fixedRules: The train, route geography, elapsed stops, damage, fuel, owned items, promises, injuries, and passenger membership cannot be silently rewritten.
Every passenger knows only what they personally witnessed or were told, and companions remain registered by stable identity until an explicit departure or death.
Dawn Junction is reachable through three route families, but opened switches, collapsed bridges, rescued settlements, and abandoned stations remain persistent facts.
generationRules: AI may create station incidents, survivors, rumors, salvage, weather, local factions, optional jobs, and short detours that obey the known route and current resources.
Every successful turn must change a route fact, resource, character relationship, item ownership, danger phase, or concrete objective fact.
Failure creates damage, lost fuel, separated companions, hostile passengers, blocked routes, or recovery missions instead of deleting the save or ending after a fixed number of turns.

The first sentence after every player action states its direct result; use at most three short beats before the next substantive decision, with no recap, repeated investigation, redundant confirmation, or atmosphere-only turn.
Each chapter takes 3–5 consequential decisions and each side job only 1–2; if two consecutive turns add no new place, person, item, threat, or chapter fact, force the main quest forward.

choiceIntents: take a direct physical or engineering action
negotiate, recruit, trade, or protect someone
scout, detour, improvise, or spend a scarce item

signatureItem.ability: Manually opens one sealed switch house or locked rail-service route and can create a new branch through a blocked region.
signatureItem.limitOrCost: It has three brass teeth that shear away after overrides; each use is permanent and the final use may strand the train on the chosen line.
signatureItem.provenance: The missing dispatcher pushed it through the station window moments before the regional power grid failed.

methods: hold the line or repair under pressure
scout a detour and spend scarce equipment
threatPalette: armed fuel thieves board from an unlit maintenance platform
floodwater undermines a bridge while the train is already committed
a tunnel fire forces passengers to choose what cargo to abandon
a panicked carriage faction tries to seize control of the route
a landslide traps survivors on the opposite track as another train rolls downhill
a wounded animal pack follows the warm engine into a stalled station
